scripts.catalog: cd .. && .venv/bin/python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; from ai_studio.n10_functions import function_catalog; path = Path('web/public/catalog.json'); path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True); path.write_text(json.dumps(function_catalog(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')"
